elements.element: The obligations apply upon expiry or termination of the Agreement.
elements.evidence: The clause applies “[u]pon expiry or termination of this Agreement for any reason.”
TrueLink “shall ... at Client's request, provide transition assistance.” Conditioning performance on Client's request is consistent with assistance being provided when needed.

elements.element: Transition assistance must be available for up to six months following expiry or termination.
elements.evidence: The assistance is required “for up to six (6) months following such expiry or termination.”

elements.element: Transition assistance is provided at TrueLink's then-current rates.
elements.evidence: The clause expressly states that assistance will be provided “at TrueLink's then-current rates.”

elements.element: TrueLink must return Customer Data to Client.
elements.evidence: TrueLink must “return to Client all data belonging to, supplied by or processed for Client,” which substantively captures Customer Data.

elements.element: Customer Data must be returned within 30 days after expiry or termination.
elements.evidence: Return is required “within thirty (30) days after such expiry or termination.”

elements.element: Customer Data must be returned in a standard machine-readable format.
elements.evidence: The clause expressly requires return “in a standard machine-readable format.”

elements.element: TrueLink must delete Customer Data after returning it.
elements.evidence: TrueLink must, “after such return, delete all such data from its systems.”

elements.element: TrueLink must certify deletion of Customer Data after its return.
elements.evidence: TrueLink must “certify such deletion to Client in writing” after the return and deletion.

elements.element: The obligations apply upon expiry or termination of the Agreement.
elements.evidence: The clause applies “[u]pon expiry or termination of this Agreement for any reason.”
TrueLink “shall ... at Client's request, provide transition assistance.”

elements.element: Transition assistance must be available for at least 90 days following expiry or termination.
elements.evidence: Required availability for up to six months permits Client to request and receive 90 days of assistance, exceeding the fallback duration.

elements.element: TrueLink must export or return Customer Data to Client.
elements.evidence: TrueLink must return all data belonging to, supplied by, or processed for Client in a machine-readable format, satisfying the data-export requirement.

elements.element: The data export must occur within 30 days after expiry or termination.
elements.evidence: The data return is expressly required within 30 days after expiry or termination.

result.reason: The added operative clause fully implements the preferred position and therefore also satisfies the fallback. It includes the required trigger, six-month assistance period, then-current rates, 30-day machine-readable data return, post-return deletion, and written deletion certification. No unrelated commercial requirement or contradiction is introduced, although numbering the new clause would improve integration with the agreement.
